verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software or AI product that collects user data and offers a model-training opt-out, so this story's axis is a category error for this product type. Its privacy practice advises clients on privacy and data-protection laws, which is a related legal service rather than a user-facing control over AI training, so it earns no credit here.
